# disClick source snapshot

Source: `https://github.com/chandler0714/disclick` at commit `4bc3680f62380a7eb63b0142461c75403d13298b` (downloaded 2026-11-02).

The independent disClick app remains owner-maintained. Joybit runs `npm run sync:disclick` to copy Swift game files into its Expo iOS module. The sync omits the standalone `@main` entry, removes account actions from the embedded game settings, and adds an external-session entry to the copied auth model. The source files in this snapshot remain unchanged.
